items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: He wanted to get together this band he had in mind. So he invited me to stay at his family's place until I got a place of my own... stayed with the Kratkas, I guess, for several weeks.

ctx.x: We were talking about the Stuyvesant, about your trips back and forth to Baltimore. When did you decide to go up there and study, take lessons and all of it, Bun?

Well, Kratka was saying that I ought to move to New York. He wanted to get together this band he had in mind. So he invited me to stay at his family's place until I got a place of my own, and so I did move up. With my parents' permission this time, and stayed with the Kratkas, I guess, for several weeks. And finally, I got a place down in the village, a little room that was being leased by Jan Kindler. He was just hanging on to it because it was still under rent control, and the rent was real cheap. And it was a…
By the way, what ever happened to Kindler in the book he was writing? You know anything about it?
